name: viewforge-3d-local
description: A separate local-venv ViewForge 3D workbench with semantic asset IR, capability maturity gates, deterministic compilation, immutable modeling, rendering, rigging, and surface smoothing.

interface.shortDescription: Compile verified 3D intent in a private local ViewForge workbench.
interface.longDescription: A side-by-side local edition of ViewForge 3D for Codex. It uses a repository-owned Python 3.11 virtual environment and separate local state, keeps the ChatGPT/Tunnel edition unchanged, validates semantic ViewForge Asset IR against evidence and capability-maturity gates, compiles only allowlisted procedural geometry, and retains immutable modeling, rendering, rigging, bounded surface smoothing, and direct artifact paths.
defaultPrompt: Use $viewforge-3d-local:viewforge-3d-router to choose a private local 3D workflow.
Use $viewforge-3d-local:compile-viewforge-asset to validate semantic IR before deterministic procedural compilation.
Smooth an approved Blend or GLB with smooth_model_surface, then inspect its QA and render.
Use get_local_artifact_path after a job so local desktop tools can open its output.
